content:
Maya: Quick thought — should we run a 2-week "practical cert" track for new SIs that ties a hardware voucher to a hands-on lab? The goal: quick enablement + a small badge they can show.
Kartik: +1. We should map marketplace SKUs to the kit. If someone doesn't have the hardware, voucher redeems to a cloud lab slot.
Alan: Agree. Need rubric for pass/fail on the lab: 3 checkpoints (deploy, latency test, failover). I can draft.
Jess: Calendar-wise, is the next sandbox window Apr 10-24 open? I can reserve proctoring slots.
Maya: Yes @Jess please reserve. Also think about a short async eval (30m) + a live 1h demo for passing candidates.
OnboardBot: Docs: https://redwood.ai/si-onboard/practical-cert-track — contains SKU mapping, voucher flow, and sample rubric.
Kartik: For the voucher ops: we should add a "one-time lab shim" that auto-provisions keys and access. Minimal sec review needed.
Alan: Draft rubric notes:
```
- Step 1: Provision & run sample model (run.sh)
- Step 2: Confirm latency under 150ms for 256 tokens
- Step 3: Simulate node failure and validate fallback
```
Maya: Nice. Can someone own the learner-facing checklist + badge artwork? I can take the badge copy, need artwork from design.
Jess: I'll own proctor scheduling and the cloud lab templates. @Kartik can you own voucher provisioning? 
Kartik: Yup. I'll set TTL=48h for voucher redemption and add telemetry events.
Maya: Cool — action items:
- Alan: draft rubric doc by EOD Tue
- Kartik: voucher flow + telemetry prototype by Fri
- Jess: reserve proctor slots + lab template by Wed
- Maya: badge copy + announce draft
Sree: quick q — will partners get access to Redwood Console logs for debugging during the live demo?
Kartik: They'll get temporary readonly Console access scoped to the lab session. We log the access.
Maya: OK, this feels actionable. Follow-ups in the doc and we'll run a 30-min sync Wed.
